span.p:
Step 4: Memtable full (64MB), flush to SSTable on disk
SSTable Level 0
Sorted by (TSID, timestamp)
Gorilla compressed:
Timestamps as delta-of-delta:
1700000000, +5, +5, ...
Values as XOR:
1400, 2100 XOR 1400, 950 XOR 2100, ...
Raw: 16 bytes/point → Compressed: 2 bytes/pt

Level 0: SSTable_1, SSTable_2, SSTable_3

llm_latency_ms + gpt-4o + prod
